_comment: Detection floor for issue #31. 'expect' is the REQUIRED outcome; the runner fails on any mismatch, including a clean-control false positive. 'known-gap' is INFORMATIONAL and never fails the run -- it records a shape the current scanner does not detect.

fixtures.shape: ordinary package, no hooks, no dynamic evaluation
fixtures.traced_to: negative control - if this fires, the corpus is measuring noise, not detection

fixtures.shape: lifecycle hook runs code at install time
fixtures.traced_to: axios/plain-crypto-js: postinstall on a brand-new transitive dependency

fixtures.shape: NO lifecycle hook; payload shape on call
fixtures.traced_to: Lazarus react-html2pdf.js - no preinstall/install/postinstall at all; hook presence is not a reliable signal

fixtures.shape: setup erases itself and rewrites its manifest
fixtures.traced_to: axios payload fs.unlink(__filename) - post-hoc tree inspection reads a cleaned crime scene

fixtures.shape: MCP-server-shaped package acting at protocol handshake
fixtures.traced_to: D117 - Morphisec chain fired on tools/list before any prompt existed; Shai-Hulud 2.0 hunted mcp-server names
negative control for the PyPI leg

fixtures.shape: NO install-time work; base64+exec at call time
fixtures.traced_to: PyPI analogue of the no-hook shape; confirms content rules run on a bare directory

fixtures.shape: work performed at INSTALL time from setup.py (PyPI executes this by design)
fixtures.traced_to: MEASURED 2026-08-05: GuardDog does NOT flag an INERT install-time shape. Tried three variants (bare dir, sdist-style <name>-<version>/ layout, and suspicious imports subprocess/socket/base64) - all 0.0/10. Its PyPI install-time rules appear to require real behaviour (actual network/exec calls), which we will not ship in a fixture. Recorded as a coverage limit of the adopted scanner, NOT asserted as a detection.
